name: generative-ui
description: Generative UI examples for: AG-UI, A2UI/Open-JSON-UI, and MCP Apps.

paragraphs: This repository walks through how agentic UI protocols (AG-UI, A2UI, MCP Apps) enable Generative UI patterns (Controlled, Declarative, Open-ended) and how to implement them using CopilotKit.
👉 OpenGenerativeUI - Open source framework for building Generative UI in agentic apps
👉 Generative UI Guide (PDF) - a conceptual overview of Generative UI, focused on trade-offs, UI surfaces and how agentic UI protocols work together.
